description: Sends a signature request built from template(s) to the given signers. When test_mode is true (default) it does NOT send real emails; set test_mode=false to send a REAL, legally-binding signature request. API: POST /signature_request/send_with_template.

message.description: Message body for the signature-request email.

signers.description: Signers to send to. Each { role, email_address, name }; role must match a template role.

role.description: Signer role name — must match a role defined on the template.

subject.description: Subject line for the signature-request email.

template_ids.description: Template id(s) to build the request from.

test_mode.description: Test mode. Default TRUE — no real emails sent. Set false to send a REAL legally-binding request.

name: dropbox_sign_send_with_template
title: Send signature request from template
